summary: Iteration 65 (Sample marketplace + sample house games seed + shop nav + mobile trivia section) tested end-to-end on shared backend + web + mobile. Backend pytest: 8/8 pass. Fun Pizza Kitchen (biz_sample_funpizza) — business_detail returns has_menu=true + has_memberships=true, menu returns exactly 8 items across Pizzas/Sides/Dessert/Coffee, 2 membership plans (Weekly Pizza Club + Coffee Club). Ambreens Salon (biz_sample_ambreens) — has_memberships=true + has_products=true, sells=['services','appointments','products','memberships'], /products returns Argan Repair Hair Serum (active), /services returns 3 services (Haircut & Style, Hair Colour, Signature Spa Facial) each with duration_min>0, service_availability seeded on profile. GET /api/games_v2/play_and_win (authed) returns >=24 cmp_smp_ house campaigns spanning all 8 game templates. Web (legacy shell, 1920 viewport): sidebar shows [data-testid='nav-shop'] labeled 'Shop' inside the 'More' group — click routes to /shop and renders rl-shop-page overlay (both storefronts visible in listings). Ambreens detail (/shop/biz_sample_ambreens) renders all 3 CTAs — shop-detail-membership ('Memberships'), shop-detail-products ('Shop Products'), shop-detail-cta ('Book Now · Earn 200'). Fun Pizza detail (/shop/biz_sample_funpizza) correctly renders shop-detail-membership ('Memberships') + shop-detail-cta ('Order Pickup · Earn 175') and OMITS shop-detail-products (correct — no products). Mobile (Expo web preview, 390x844): Games hub renders new TRIVIA section — trivia-hub-card, trivia-host-btn, trivia-join-btn all present with correct testIDs; trivia-hub-card navigates to /trivia. Existing predict-win-card + quick-game-spin/trivia/lyric still render. ONE BUG FOUND: web /shop/memberships/{plan_id} and /shop/services/{svc_id} routes both render an 'Unavailable' / 'Services unavailable.' state for the seeded sample plan (mplan_sample_biz_sample_ambreens_glam) and service (svc_sample_biz_sample_ambreens_0) — the shell chrome loads but the page body says the item can't be resolved. Backend detail lookups for these plan_id / service_id likely need matching consumer routes wired for the light-shell screens, OR the light shell is fetching from a route that hasn't been extended to sample data. Suspect the fetcher expects a merchant lookup by owner instead of resolving from marketplace_profiles/system_sample owner_user_id. Reporting to main agent for fix.

critical_code_review_comments: services/marketplace_samples.py uses owner_user_id='system_sample' but does not seed a corresponding entry in the users collection — if any consumer detail path does a users lookup on the owner, the sample screens will 404. Suggest either creating a stub system_sample user or relaxing the join.
The Fun Pizza cover URL depends on a third-party CDN that appears to block hotlinking; move critical hero assets to /app/frontend/public or Unsplash.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Sample seed is idempotent and confirmed on backend. Web sidebar Shop link (data-testid nav-shop) + /shop overlay + Ambreens/FunPizza business detail all work with correct testIDs (shop-detail-membership, shop-detail-products, shop-detail-cta). Mobile games tab trivia section (trivia-hub-card, trivia-host-btn, trivia-join-btn) all wired and route correctly to /trivia, /trivia/rooms/create, /trivia/join respectively. OPEN BUG: web /shop/memberships/{id} and /shop/services/{id} render an unavailable-body state for the sample plan_id (mplan_sample_biz_sample_ambreens_glam) and service_id (svc_sample_biz_sample_ambreens_0). Reproduce by hitting those URLs after cookie login as test@bigfm.dubai — chrome loads but the interior body shows 'Services unavailable.' / 'Unavailable.'. Root cause likely in the light-shell fetch (probably a merchant-scoped lookup that doesn't match owner_user_id='system_sample'), NOT in the seed itself (backend detail endpoints for business/menu/products/services all return 200).
rca of the issue: The sample storefronts are seeded with owner_user_id='system_sample' but no corresponding user document is created. If ShopMembershipRadioLife / ShopServiceRadioLife (or their fetch layer) resolves the plan/service via an owner-scoped endpoint that joins on users, the fetch returns empty and the UI renders the unavailable fallback. Fix by (a) creating a stub system_sample user, OR (b) ensuring consumer detail fetches use marketplace_profiles-only lookups keyed on plan_id/service_id.
